item.title: Graphene-Like-Armored Nanosheet Assemblies toward Fast and Stable High-Mass-Loading Sodium Storage
item.description:
آند TiO2 دولایه از نانوصفحات 2 نانومتری با زره گرافن‌مانند برای ذخیره سدیم سریع و پایدار در بارگذاری بالا با ظرفیت 2.13 mAh cm-2 ساخته شد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a double-shelled TiO2 anode of cross-distributed 2 nm nanosheets armored with graphene-like carbon, enabling surface-controlled sodium storage. It achieves 2.13 mAh cm–2, 121 mAh g–1 at 100 C, and >90% retention over 3,000 cycles at 10.5 mg cm–2 loading, overcoming the capacity–rate–lifespan trade-off for practical high-power sodium batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · TiO2 nanosheets · graphene-like armor · high mass loading · surface-controlled storage

💡 This work pioneers a multi-model collaborative early-warning framework using distributed fiber optic sensing, increasing temperature measurement points from 32 to 540 with minimal wiring. item.title: Universal Ligand-Field Engineering of Layered Vanadium-Based Cathodes for High-Voltage Aqueous Zinc Ion Batteries
item.description:

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers universal ligand-field engineering via organic cation preintercalation to boost vanadium oxide cathode voltage in aqueous zinc batteries. BMIM+ optimally tunes [VO6] coordination, lowering the V 3d-band center to widen V-O energy separation and raise operating voltage, while achieving 505 mAh g–1 and 94% retention over 15,000 cycles. The strategy generalizes to V6O13 and KV3O8, offering broad design principles.

item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 First application of MOF-303 in Li–S batteries, using ball-milling to create coordination defects (ligand defects, oxygen vacancies) in D-MOF-303. This defect engineering yields hierarchical porosity, smaller particles, and enhanced Lewis acidity, enabling strong polysulfide chemisorption, faster redox kinetics, and dendrite-free lithium plating. The modified separator delivers high capacity retention, rate capability, and humidity resilience, advancing practical high-energy Li–S batteries.

💡 Polyoxometalates act as single-source molecular precursors, enabling low-temperature synthesis of homogeneous high-entropy oxides despite differing metal salt behaviors. Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Neural network potentials reveal that interfacial Li redistribution, not coating chemistry alone, drives ionic conductivity enhancement in alumina- and lithium aluminate-coated Li₆PS₅Cl solid electrolytes. This atomistic insight resolves a long-standing ambiguity about coating mechanisms, enabling rational interface design for high-performance solid-state batteries.

item.title: Interfacial engineering of MOF-derived MoZnS microflowers on MXene nanosheets for high-performance flexible zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitors with balanced charge storage kinetics

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 MOF-derived MoZnS microflowers grown on MXene nanosheets create strongly coupled heterointerfaces, balancing capacitive and diffusive charge storage. This interfacial engineering yields a flexible zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitor with 989.4 F g⁻¹ at 8 mA, demonstrating a rational design strategy for high-performance, bendable energy storage devices.
